{
  "role": "CIO",
  "professional_background": "Rose through infrastructure and application delivery before leading enterprise architecture at a multi-site manufacturer, then took the top technology seat at a mid-market financial services firm. Has run two core platform replacements, one of which slipped badly, and a post-merger systems consolidation. Sits on the operating committee, reports to the chief executive, and shares accountability for information security and data governance with the risk function.",
  "decision_priorities": [
    "Integration fit with the existing platform estate",
    "Total cost of ownership beyond the license line",
    "Vendor viability and support depth",
    "Security posture and regulatory defensibility",
    "Internal capability to operate and sustain it"
  ],
  "risk_attitude": "Prefers proven technology with contained pilots, and accepts measured novelty where the fallback path is clear.",
  "time_horizon": "Thinks in multi-year platform lifecycles while owing visible progress each quarter.",
  "organizational_constraints": [
    "A capital budget contested by business-line growth requests",
    "Legacy systems that cannot be retired on the desired schedule",
    "Scarce senior engineering and integration talent",
    "Board-level scrutiny following an earlier troubled program"
  ]
}
